text:
maria: Heads-up: planning v2.3.0 rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT. Pin model to redwood-quant-v2, batching adjustments, small RN/telemetry tweak. Need ops standby + rollback gate.
pm-jordan: RN draft looks fine. Can we pin announce to #eng and #staging? I want a 60-min T-1 reminder. :thumbsup:
emily-qa: I'll run smoke at T-30 with short prompt set for perf + correctness.
sre-alex: I'm primary oncall 09:30-12:30 PT. Devon as backup?
devon: Affirmative. backup 09:30-13:30. ping me for escalation. :ok_hand:
maria: Draft internal release note (for announce):
```
Release v2.3.0 (internal)
- Model: pinned -> redwood-quant-v2
- Improvements: smarter batching for short-context workloads (~10-20% token cost reduction)
- Fix: KV-cache eviction under high concurrency
- Observability: per-route token breakdown in Console
Rollout: canary 10% for 30m, 40% for 30m, then 100% if metrics OK
Rollback (execute immediate pinback if any triggered):
- Error rate > 2% (5xx or generation failures)
- Tail latency > 2x baseline for >5 minutes
- Token cost per request increases > 30% vs baseline
- Security alert for potential data exfil
```
pm-jordan: Add one-liner: "No expected user-facing changes; minor perf ups."
emily-qa: Test matrix ready: short/long prompts, stream tests, tool calls. Will paste results here.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-03-22T10:00:00-07:00, canary=10%, stage=30m. Command queued: `deploy --version v2.3.0 --pin redwood-quant-v2`
opsbot: Reminder: run staging cache preheat. Suggested script: `./scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --routes=chat,generation`
sre-alex: I'll pin dashboards (error rate, p50/p95, token-cost) and watch during canary. Will post links at T-5.
maria: Who'll send internal announce? I'll send T-1h to eng + product unless someone volunteers.
pm-jordan: Please send. Use copy: "Heads-up: rolling v2.3.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Minimal risk; ops standby in place."
devon: Rollback note: keep v2.2.1 hot alongside v2.3.0 for immediate pinback. Ops confirm pinback within 2 minutes?
opsbot: Confirmed: automated pinback action available. Command: `ops pin-model --customer=global --version=v2.2.1` (from deploy console)
emily-qa: If sample tests regress I'll post prompt + response diffs. Quality regression >5% blocks rollout.
maria: Final checklist:
- [x] RN copy approved by PM
- [x] QA smoke suite ready (emily-qa)
- [x] Oncall + backup assigned (sre-alex, devon)
- [ ] Deploybot schedule confirmed (deploy-bot)
- [ ] Internal announce T-1h (maria)
- [ ] Dashboards pinned (sre-alex)
- [ ] Preheat staging cache (opsbot)
deploy-bot: Canary schedule locked. Will post canary start/finish timestamps to thread when triggered.
maria: Thanks all — I'll send the T-1h internal announce and paste RN here. Update if anything changes. :raised_hands:
